formatDescription: A 2dm file is a text-based 2D mesh file format created by the Surface-Water Modeling System (SMS) to store unstructured mesh geometry. It is a plain text ASCII file that stores the spatial framework for two-dimensional numerical modeling and includes elements such as spatial coordinates (x, y, z elevations/bathymetry), element connections (triangles or quadrilaterals), and material types.
